concepts.preferred_label: Vascular Tumor of the Thyroid with Metastasis
support_spans: Costal Biopsy: Pointed to VTC metastasis
Sinonasal Tumor Biopsy: Confirmed VTC metastasis
concepts.why: The biopsies of both the costal and sinonasal tumors confirmed VTC metastasis, indicating a vascular tumor of the thyroid with metastasis.

support_spans: considerable uptake regarding rib and vertebral lesions
contradict_spans: sinonasal tumor had low uptake, indicative of thyroid tissue with low iodine avidity
concepts.why: The significantly elevated serum thyroglobulin and considerable uptake regarding rib and vertebral lesions suggest papillary thyroid carcinoma with metastasis, but the low uptake of the sinonasal tumor is less typical.

support_spans: considerable uptake regarding rib and vertebral lesions
contradict_spans: sinonasal tumor had low uptake, indicative of thyroid tissue with low iodine avidity
concepts.why: The significantly elevated serum thyroglobulin and considerable uptake regarding rib and vertebral lesions suggest follicular thyroid carcinoma with metastasis, but the low uptake of the sinonasal tumor is less typical.

contradict_spans: sinonasal tumor had low uptake, indicative of thyroid tissue with low iodine avidity
concepts.why: The significantly elevated serum thyroglobulin suggests medullary thyroid carcinoma with metastasis, but the low uptake of the sinonasal tumor and lack of other specific markers are less typical.

contradict_spans: sinonasal tumor had low uptake, indicative of thyroid tissue with low iodine avidity
concepts.why: The significantly elevated serum thyroglobulin suggests anaplastic thyroid carcinoma with metastasis, but the low uptake of the sinonasal tumor and lack of other specific markers are less typical.

contradict_spans: sinonasal tumor had low uptake, indicative of thyroid tissue with low iodine avidity
concepts.why: The significantly elevated serum thyroglobulin suggests Hürthle cell carcinoma with metastasis, but the low uptake of the sinonasal tumor and lack of other specific markers are less typical.

concepts.preferred_label: Vascular Tumor of the Thyroid with Low Iodine Avidity and Metastasis
concepts.why: The sinonasal tumor had low uptake, indicative of thyroid tissue with low iodine avidity, which explains the uncovered finding of low iodine avidity in the sinonasal tumor.
